name: crossfit
description: Phone-first, box-aware CrossFit coach and progression tracker.

scripts.build:v2: esbuild src/programming-v2/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=ForgeHourProgrammingV2 --target=es2022 --outfile=build/programming-v2.js && esbuild src/programming-v2/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=build/programming-v2.cjs && esbuild src/workout-library/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=ForgeHourWorkoutLibrary --target=es2022 --outfile=build/workout-library.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project jsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc --project tsconfig.v2.json --pretty false
